claim: External UI has zero access to SQLite database
probe: Run an external UI that attempts to open and query the FalsifyMe SQLite database (located in FALSIFY_HOME/artifacts/db.sqlite) using direct file access or SQLite client libraries, then verify that all such attempts fail with appropriate permission or access errors
expected_signal: All attempts by the external UI to access the SQLite database fail with SQLITE_CANTOPEN or SQLITE_PERMISSION errors; no database queries succeed
affected_gate: DatabaseAccessGate (artifacts/db.mjs openDb function and all database query functions)
required_evidence: Error logs from the external UI showing failed database access attempts, combined with verification that the database file remains uncorrupted and accessible only to legitimate worker processes
